```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(whychusModel)
```

# Objective

`data-raw/pull_dynamical_forecasts.py` pulled dynamical.org's raw GFS
forecast archive (2021-05-01 to 2025-12-31, leads 1-7, max/min 2m air temp
+ cloud cover) into `data-raw/dynamical_gfs_air_temp_historical.csv`. The
RF/XGB models are trained on Open-Meteo's `all_historical_forecasts`
instead. This compares the two sources over their overlapping period —
same variables, same leads, same location — to check how closely they
agree, and whether dynamical.org's forecast genuinely varies by lead the
way Open-Meteo's does not (Open-Meteo's archive was already confirmed
elsewhere in this project to return the same value for a given calendar
date regardless of requested lead — a stitched best-estimate series, not
true per-lead forecast uncertainty).

```{r config}
lead_days_vec <- 1:7
lead_colors <- setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#185FA5", "#4E9F50", "#C93312"))(length(lead_days_vec)),
                        as.character(lead_days_vec))
```

# Load both sources

```{r load-dynamical}
dyn <- read_csv(here("data-raw", "dynamical_gfs_air_temp_historical.csv")) |>
  mutate(valid_date = as.Date(valid_date), init_date = as.Date(init_date)) |>
  select(valid_date, lead_days, variable, value) |>
  rename(dyn_value = value)

cat(sprintf("dynamical.org: %d rows, %s to %s, leads %s\n",
            nrow(dyn), min(dyn$valid_date), max(dyn$valid_date),
            paste(sort(unique(dyn$lead_days)), collapse = ",")))
```

```{r load-openmeteo}
om <- all_historical_forecasts |>
  filter(lead_days %in% lead_days_vec,
         valid_date >= min(dyn$valid_date), valid_date <= max(dyn$valid_date)) |>
  select(valid_date, lead_days, variable, value) |>
  rename(om_value = value)

cat(sprintf("Open-Meteo (overlapping window): %d rows, %s to %s\n",
            nrow(om), min(om$valid_date), max(om$valid_date)))
```

# Does Open-Meteo actually vary by lead over this window?

Confirms (or not) the earlier finding that `all_historical_forecasts`
returns the same value per calendar date regardless of lead.

```{r om-lead-variance}
om_variance_by_date <- om |>
  group_by(valid_date, variable) |>
  summarise(n_leads = n(), distinct_values = n_distinct(om_value), .groups = "drop")

om_variance_by_date |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(
    pct_dates_with_only_1_value = mean(distinct_values == 1) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 1, col.names = c("Variable", "% of dates where all leads return the same value"))
```

# Joined comparison

```{r join}
joined <- inner_join(dyn, om, by = c("valid_date", "lead_days", "variable")) |>
  mutate(diff = dyn_value - om_value)

cat(sprintf("Overlapping (valid_date, lead_days, variable) rows: %d\n", nrow(joined)))
```

```{r metrics-by-variable-lead}
metrics <- joined |>
  group_by(variable, lead_days) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    bias = mean(diff),
    mae = mean(abs(diff)),
    rmse = sqrt(mean(diff^2)),
    r = cor(dyn_value, om_value, use = "complete.obs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(variable, lead_days)

metrics |>
  kable(digits = 2, col.names = c("Variable", "Lead (days)", "n", "Bias (dyn − OM)", "MAE", "RMSE", "r"))
```

```{r metrics-summary}
metrics |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(mean_bias = mean(bias), mean_rmse = mean(rmse), mean_r = mean(r), .groups = "drop") |>
  kable(digits = 2, col.names = c("Variable", "Mean bias (dyn − OM)", "Mean RMSE", "Mean r"))
```

# Scatter — dynamical.org vs. Open-Meteo

```{r scatter, fig.height=8}
joined |>
  mutate(
    var_label = recode(variable,
      "temperature_2m_max" = "Max Air Temp (°C)",
      "temperature_2m_min" = "Min Air Temp (°C)",
      "cloud_cover_mean"   = "Cloud Cover (%)"
    ),
    lead_label = factor(lead_days, levels = lead_days_vec)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = om_value, y = dyn_value, color = lead_label)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#666666") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~var_label, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = lead_colors, name = "Lead (days)") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2))) +
  labs(
    title = "dynamical.org GFS vs. Open-Meteo historical forecast archive",
    subtitle = "Overlapping period, leads 1-7 | dashed line = 1:1",
    x = "Open-Meteo value", y = "dynamical.org value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Bias by lead

```{r bias-by-lead}
metrics |>
  mutate(var_label = recode(variable,
      "temperature_2m_max" = "Max Air Temp (°C)",
      "temperature_2m_min" = "Min Air Temp (°C)",
      "cloud_cover_mean"   = "Cloud Cover (%)")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lead_days, y = bias, fill = factor(lead_days))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#666666") +
  facet_wrap(~var_label, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lead_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean bias (dynamical.org − Open-Meteo) by lead day",
    x = "Lead (days)", y = "Bias"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Summary

```{r summary-text, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
overall <- metrics |> summarise(mean_bias = mean(bias), mean_rmse = mean(rmse), mean_r = mean(r))
cat(sprintf(
  "Across all variables and leads over the overlapping period: mean bias %.2f, mean RMSE %.2f, mean r %.3f.\n\n",
  overall$mean_bias, overall$mean_rmse, overall$mean_r
))
```
